english.note: For the literal geological event, 地震 is the all-purpose Cantonese word.
Use this for an earthquake or ground-shaking event.
Use this specifically for a tremor that is an earthquake.

examples.english: That earthquake shook the whole house and knocked all the cups onto the floor.
examples.traditional: 嗰次地震震到全屋啲杯都跌晒落地。
examples.jyutping: go2 ci3 dei6 zan3 zan3 dou3 cyun4 uk1 di1 bui1 dou1 dit3 saai3 lok6 dei6

examples.english: There was a quake last night; it shook my bed all over.
examples.traditional: 尋晚有地震，震到我張床都郁晒。
examples.jyutping: cam4 maan5 jau5 dei6 zan3 zan3 dou3 ngo5 zoeng1 cong4 dou1 juk1 saai3

examples.english: Last night's tremor kept me awake all night.
examples.traditional: 尋晚嗰場地震震到我成晚瞓唔着。
examples.jyutping: cam4 maan5 go2 coeng4 dei6 zan3 zan3 dou3 ngo5 sing4 maan5 fan3 m4 zoek6
